actors.name: Owner of Fenwick & Sloane
actors.private_context: Owner has run the store for 31 years. She has two deputies: one runs buying, the other runs operations. Staff have started asking openly about succession. Her accountant has advised settling the decision before seasonal hires arrive. She has not yet decided or announced who will be general manager.

actors.name: Deputy (Buying)
actors.private_context: One of the two deputies at Fenwick & Sloane, responsible for buying. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Has not been told the decision.

actors.name: Deputy (Operations)
actors.private_context: One of the two deputies at Fenwick & Sloane, responsible for operations. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Has not been told the decision.

shared_context: Fenwick & Sloane is a store. The owner is retiring and will name one of her two deputies as general manager. Holiday trading starts on November 1. The owner's accountant has advised settling the decision before seasonal hires arrive. Staff have been asking openly about the succession.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No announcement has been made yet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the owner actually named one of her two deputies as general manager before 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
